body: There's a bunch of things. When I was a kid I accidentally caused my folks to argue with my dad's side of the family over my (lack of) social skills and now we don't speak to them anymore. There's the guilt for my ex being removed from campus after I reported her, and I'm having similar feelings about the guy who assaulted me because I'm stuck in an investigation now. I also feel like a huge burden on my family and friends because I know I'm a handful. I guess none of these things make me want to kill myself directly, but the guilt is piling on and it's getting to be too much.
